deepdive.sec: Out-of-Home (OOH) Advertising / Transit & Digital Media Infrastructure

bull_bear.body:
- Aim to become more "dividend-driven" for investors (no specific policy/number given).
- Self-reinforcing flywheel: scale → cash → redeploy into low-risk civic infra → extends network ("compounding flywheel" to 100 cities).
- Bill discounting on receivables explicitly avoided to keep cost down.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body:
- **Receivables / working capital:** +~80% YoY to INR 317 cr; multi-city compliance lag is the central risk. Quantum >6m vs <6m not disclosed (analyst asked, not answered). Milestone-billing fix unproven until Q3 FY27.
- **Execution slippage** on Kolkata Renaissance and Bangalore Metro ramp (maturity lag on new geographies).
- **Conservative-vs-actual margin** — repeated analyst push that 30% is achievable; mgmt holding 25-27%.
- **Minimum-guarantee (fixed) license model** = downside if utilization/occupancy disappoints (occupancy rate question cut off, not answered).
- **Government/PSU client concentration risk** (NPCI, SBI, PNB cited) and BFSI/FMCG/education cyclicality.
- **Maiden call / limited disclosure** — no segment revenue split, no occupancy data, no receivables aging given.
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: - Confident, vision-heavy MD (Shripad Ashtekar); strong on narrative ("not a billboard company", "Signs of Tomorrow", data/AI flywheel) but light on hard disclosure — several specific analyst asks (receivables aging, occupancy rate, segment split, merger valuation) were deflected or cut by moderator. Candid on the receivables problem and the chosen (unusual) milestone-billing fix. Committed to a regular (at least half-yearly) call cadence. Slightly promotional on optionality (drone shows, 100-city ambition, INR 1,000 cr by 2029) but appropriately non-committal on the big targets.
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body:
- The real story is a **business-model upgrade**, not just growth: shifting from intermediary/agency-led to ~75% direct, long-tenure (avg ~14 yr) advertiser contracts with anchor-client mix at ~29% — this is what drove the ~600 bps EBITDA margin jump and is the durable re-rating lever.
- **Receivables, not margin, is the swing factor** for the stock — the +80% receivable build funded the +INR 192 cr direct-revenue growth; if milestone-billing works by Q3 FY27, cash conversion improves materially; if not, the growth quality is questioned.
- License cost is **fixed (minimum-guarantee), not revenue-linked** — confirms genuine operating leverage on utilization, supporting the 30% margin optionality the analysts kept pushing.
- DOOH is the high-margin engine (digital ad space tripled Q3→Q4) but needs 4-6 month maturity per asset — near-term yield lags the capex, so FY27 margin uplift is back-half weighted.
- The "asset-light orchestration" + Captura AI/data layer is the attempt to scale beyond owned assets (Tier-2/3) without proportional capex — the key long-term scalability bet.
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

business.body:
- **Transit media (primary focus):** metros, electric/green buses, airports, bus queue shelters, street furniture — anchored on long-term contracts; ~largest transit-media operator and largest bus-queue-shelter operator nationally. Industry transit segment grew 22% in 2025 to INR 20.2 bn (~30% of OOH).
- **Digital OOH:** highest-margin format; digital ad space grew 25,000→80,000 sq ft Q3→Q4 (~3x). Industry DOOH grew INR 7 bn (2024) → INR 12.2 bn (2025), ~18% of OOH, programmatic deals doubled to 30%. First-mover (DOOH from 2017, Kolkata Airport).
- **Conventional/static media:** third format. Transit + digital = ~48% of top line today.
- **Captura:** proprietary AI media-planning + CRM platform (AI/video analytics, geospatial planning, PIN-code-level TG density) — positions company as "brand custodian/consultant" vs plain platform.
- **Merger:** Pressman (~INR 14-15 cr rev) merged into Signpost (~INR 350 cr); Pressman promoters converted to non-promoter (family losses, age/retirement).

latest_quarter.body:
- Gross margin ~41%; cost of services = license/lease cost + production/display cost (Wi-Fi, power). Mostly minimum-guarantee (fixed) license — NOT revenue-linked — so operating leverage as utilization ramps.
- New assets need ~4-6 month maturity before yielding decent revenue (vintage-asset effect); capex/license fees front-loaded → short-term mismatch that normalizes.
- Targeting 6-7% reduction in cost of services in FY27 → direct PBT funnel; EBITDA 25-27% guided with upside toward 30%.
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

latest_quarter.body:
- **Q4 FY26 (this):** Maiden earnings call. Q4 rev INR 162 cr (+46% YoY, +14% QoQ); FY26 rev INR 576 cr (+27%); EBITDA INR 147 cr (+65%, margin 25.5% +~600 bps); PAT INR 70 cr (>2x, margin 12.2%); EPS INR 13.14. Footprint 4 (2024)→32 cities; ~75% direct revenue, anchor mix ~29%, avg contract tenure ~14 yr. Receivables +~80% YoY to INR 317 cr — milestone-billing fix promised by Q3 FY27. FY27 guide: 20%+ rev growth, 25-27% EBITDA (aspire ~30%), capex INR 60-75 cr.
- _Next Q → check: (1) receivable days / cash conversion improvement (the Q3 FY27 "surprise"); (2) margin toward 27-30% on 6-7% cost-of-services cut; (3) Bangalore Metro station ramp (25→67) + Kolkata Renaissance implementation; (4) DOOH yield maturing (the 25k→80k sq ft ramp); (5) asset-light/Tier-2/3 traction; (6) dividend policy; (7) any segment-split / occupancy disclosure._
latest_quarter.title: QoQ change log (fill each quarter)

outlook.body:
- **Revenue growth:** 20%+ ("double figure") in FY27, similar to FY26's +27%. ~48% of FY26 revenue already "in the engine"/signed bucket entering FY27.
- **Margin:** EBITDA 25-27% guided; internal aspiration toward ~30% via 6-7% reduction in cost of services (flows straight to PBT). Mgmt acknowledged guidance is conservative vs operating-leverage potential.
- **Working capital:** milestone-based (per-city) billing being rolled out to cut the 90-120 day OOH receivable cycle; "humongous surprise" / drastic days reduction targeted by Q3 FY27. Bill discounting explicitly rejected (adds cost).
- **Capex:** INR 60-75 cr in FY27 across infrastructure, capacity expansion, technology.
- **Footprint:** mid-term ambition 100 cities (from 32 now); expansion into smart cities / tourism / pilgrimage hubs (Varanasi, Puri, Ayodhya, Tirupati).
- **Asset-light layer:** new data/AI-led "asset-light orchestration" model for Tier-2/3 (foot-on-street survey of 100+ cities done; adding 70-80 data layers — e-commerce/payment/travel-pattern).
- **Aspiration:** crossing INR 1,000 cr revenue by ~2029 floated by analyst; MD hopeful but would not commit.
outlook.title: Guidance (CRITICAL — verify next quarter)

outlook.body:
- No formal "order book" (media-contract business), but **contract tenure is the moat:** avg remaining contract tenure ~14 years; some civic contracts 40+ years lineage; competitive techno-commercial bids typically 7-20 years.
- New/ramping contracts: Bangalore Metro (67 stations lined up; 18→25 live, ahead of plan; 2-3 yr brand contracts being signed); Kolkata Streetscape Renaissance project (60-70% implementation expected by Sep-Oct, pre-Durga Puja); OMC petrol-pump hoardings; electric/premium bus fleets (Mumbai, Hyderabad, Goa); Mumbai bus queue shelters (3,000 units, 20% refurbishment mandate over 3 yrs, ~11% done).
- FY26 added ~866,000 sq ft across metro/transit/digital; activated 9 new cities.
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body:
- **Tier-2/Tier-3 ("real Bharat") expansion** — asset-light, data/AI-led; "self-serve" programmatic widening the advertiser base for aspirational brands.
- **Pilgrimage/tourism geographies** (Varanasi, Puri, Ayodhya, Tirupati, Shimla, Atal Setu corridor) — seasonal/travel-pattern monetization.
- **New experiential formats** — drone shows (e.g., Nariman Point 10-min show) as new OOH property.
- **DOOH yield uplift** — "build spaces, not sell spaces"; premiumization + firmer rates.
- **AI-led department** being added in FY27 ("Signs of Tomorrow" data/tech vision).
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: Signpost printed a strong maiden-call year — FY26 revenue +27% to INR 576 cr, EBITDA +65% to INR 147 cr (margin +~600 bps to 25.5%), PAT more than doubled to INR 70 cr — driven by a deliberate shift from low-quality intermediary work to direct, long-tenure advertiser relationships (~75% direct revenue, ~14-yr avg remaining contract life) and a footprint jump from 4 cities at 2024 listing to 32 cities. The key tension is a working-capital stress: receivables jumped ~80% YoY to INR 317 cr on multi-city campaigns needing region-by-region compliance — management is moving to milestone-based billing and promises "a humongous surprise" by Q3 FY27, while guiding 20%+ revenue growth and 25-27% EBITDA (with internal aspiration toward ~30% via 6-7% cost-of-services reduction).
